level1.prompt: Jasmine with a crush or a partner is…

options.label: We
options.t: Clingy mode: wants to see them daily and share every detail.

options.label: Me
options.t: Solo mode: loves hard, still guards solo nights and bestie nights.

level1.prompt: You show Jasmine the angry text you're about to send. Bad idea. Jasmine…

options.label: Soft
options.t: "I get why you're mad." Holds you first, talks you down later.

level1.prompt: Picture Jasmine's future home on a big holiday. It's…

options.label: Classic
options.t: The classic: rituals, the family table, parents at ease.

options.label: Own
options.t: A remix: her own rituals, her own rules, no template.

level1.prompt: Jasmine gets a surprise bonus. By Friday…

options.label: Venture
options.t: A flight is booked. Life is short.

level1.prompt: Talking plans and life progress, Jasmine is…

options.label: Push
options.t: Ambitious: wants real wins and a direction, soon.

options.label: Easy
options.t: Unbothered: who gets promoted or married when is not her business.

level1.prompt: Lines, house rules, what's fair: Jasmine is…

options.label: Rules
options.t: Rulebook: the same rules for everyone is the only fair way.

options.label: Context
options.t: Case by case: rules are fixed, people aren't.

cards.prompt: Jasmine and an old close friend haven't texted in four months. How does Jasmine feel?
cards.ownerSaid: Kind of stings. Someone should've texted. Them.

cards.prompt: Jasmine is offered a year in a brand-new city. Life here is good. Jasmine...
cards.b: Stays. The people and routines are here
cards.ownerSaid: Stay. My people, my spots, my Thursday thing.

cards.prompt: Last time a friend of Jasmine's was clearly in the wrong with someone, she...
cards.a: Told the friend straight that it was wrong.
cards.b: Took the friend for bubble tea first, raised it later.
cards.ownerSaid: Took them for bubble tea first. Brought it up on the walk back.

cards.prompt: On a normal week with a partner or closest friend, Jasmine would rather...
cards.a: Share every free evening and narrate the whole day.
cards.b: Keep some nights solo, no explaining needed.
cards.ownerSaid: We can do nothing together for hours and it's perfect. + They get a play-by-play of my day. Photos of lunch included.

cards.prompt: The crew is getting ready to go out, ride in 10 minutes. Jasmine is...
cards.a: Ready in six minutes, hoodie on
cards.b: Doing a full fit check in every mirror
cards.ownerSaid: Ready in six minutes. Hoodie, keys, done.

cards.prompt: Jasmine's sibling keeps needing a rescue, and the parents say 'help, you're family.' Jasmine is the…
cards.b: Deadline. 'Last time' comes with an actual date.
cards.ownerSaid: Grumbler. I help, then vent about it all week.

cards.prompt: Last time a friend's plan cost way more than Jasmine wanted to spend, she...
cards.a: Went, paid, and lived on noodles after.
cards.b: Admitted it was over budget, after three drafts.
cards.ownerSaid: Went, paid, and ate instant noodles for a week.

cards.prompt: Months of small clashes with someone close, nobody at fault. Jasmine would...
cards.a: Make a deal and give it time.
cards.b: Call it. Not a fit is reason enough.
cards.ownerSaid: Sat them down and made an actual deal.

cards.prompt: Jasmine's family says 'absolutely not' to a plan. What does Jasmine do?
cards.a: Sends a sibling or an aunt in first to soften them up.
cards.b: Says 'I'll think about it,' waits till they forget, does it.
cards.ownerSaid: Sent a sibling or an aunt in first to soften them up.

cards.prompt: Game night. A friend wins Uno with a stack that isn't in the official rules. Jasmine...
cards.a: Pulls up the official rules and reads them out
cards.b: Lets it slide. They haven't won all night
cards.ownerSaid: Let it slide. They haven't won a single round all night.

cards.prompt: Someone Jasmine's age posts huge news: dream job, dream school. What would she do?
cards.a: Double-tap and forget it by the next video.
cards.ownerSaid: Sent it to a friend: 'wait, are we behind?'

cards.prompt: Jasmine moves in with someone. The sink is full and nobody moves. What does Jasmine do?
cards.a: Runs it like home: nobody sits till the dishes are done.
cards.b: Splits chores by what each of them hates least.
cards.ownerSaid: Split by what we each hate least. I'll take trash.

level3.prompt: Which of these 12 are the real Jasmine? Pick 5.

cards.name: Compliment sandwich chef
cards.heart: I say it softly so you can actually hear it.

cards.name: Close Friends list: 4
cards.heart: The ones I choose always know it.

cards.name: The honest review nobody asked for
cards.heart: I'd rather annoy you than lie to you.

cards.name: Limited-edition energy
cards.heart: I charge myself first, so I have more to give.

cards.name: Yes first, bank app later
cards.heart: Breaking my own rules for my people? No regrets.

cards.name: Relationship mechanic
cards.heart: I don't quit on people I chose.

cards.name: Minimalist on purpose
cards.heart: Less stuff, more room to breathe.

cards.name: Dating, not merging
cards.heart: I'm me first. Then I'm someone's someone.

cards.name: Mayor of every group chat
cards.heart: Nobody stays a stranger for long around me.

cards.name: My passcode, my dignity
cards.heart: My privacy doesn't owe anyone an explanation.

cards.name: Head over heels, eyes open
cards.heart: I love all the way, and I know where the door is.

stingPick.prompt: Which of these 4 lines would leave Jasmine speechless for three seconds?

lines.t: You call it a calculated risk. You did the math afterward.
One ask from a friend and your budget rules vanish. They only ever apply to you.
Friends your age settle down and you say you're fine. You've already started a plan.
You'll write them five paragraphs. Helping them move is a separate negotiation.

pickTheRoast.prompt: Pick the roast Jasmine would laugh at hardest.

lines.t: Sent me a payment request for $3.47. For fries. With a fries emoji.
Has ordered the exact same thing at our spot since the day we met.
Says 'I'm saving this month.' Pays for everyone's bubble tea anyway.
Asked for a quick opinion once. Got notes, bullet points and a follow-up.
Knows the barista's name, the barista's dog's name and its birthday.
Says 'we're keeping it casual.' Already knows their coffee order by heart.
